option.name: -a
tip: Number of KDF rounds when saving a private key.
The default is 32 rounds.

option.name: -A
tip: Generate host keys of all default key types if they do not already exist.

option.name: -b
tip: Number of bits in the key to create.
The default is 3072 bits for RSA; ECDSA keys support 256, 384 or 521 bits.

option.name: -B
tip: Show the bubblebabble digest of a key.

option.name: -c
tip: Change the comment in the private and public key files.

option.name: -C
tip: Provides a new comment.

option.name: -D
tip: Download the public keys provided by the PKCS#11 shared library at the given path.

option.name: -e
tip: Read a private or public OpenSSH key file and print a public key to stdout in the format given by -m.
The default export format is RFC4716.

option.name: -E
tip: Hash algorithm used when displaying fingerprints.
The default is sha256.

option.name: -f
tip: Specify the filename of the key file.

option.name: -F
tip: Search a known_hosts file for a host.

option.name: -g
tip: Use generic DNS format when printing fingerprint resource records with -r.

option.name: -h
tip: When signing a key, create a host certificate instead of a user certificate.

option.name: -H
tip: Hash a known_hosts file.
The original content is moved to a file with a .old suffix.

option.name: -i
tip: Read an unencrypted private (or public) key file in the format given by -m and print an OpenSSH public key to stdout.
The default import format is RFC4716.

option.name: -I
tip: Specify the key identity when signing a public key.

option.name: -k
tip: Generate a KRL (Key Revocation List) file at the location given by -f, revoking every key presented on the command line.

option.name: -K
tip: Download resident keys from a FIDO authenticator to the current directory.

option.name: -l
tip: Show the fingerprint of a public key file.
If combined with -v, a visual ASCII art representation is supplied.

option.name: -L
tip: Prints the contents of one or more certificates.

option.name: -m
tip: Specify a key format for key generation, the -i (import), -e (export) conversion options, and the -p passphrase change.
The default format when exporting public keys is RFC4716.

next.name: PEM
tip: PEM format.

next.name: PKCS8
tip: PKCS#8 format.

next.name: RFC4716
tip: RFC 4716 format.

option.name: -M
tip: Moduli generation or screening operations.

next.name: generate
tip: Generate candidate DH (Diffie-Hellman) primes.

next.name: screen
tip: Screen candidate DH primes for safety.

option.name: -n
tip: Specify one or more principals (user or host names) to be included in a certificate when signing a key.
Multiple principals may be specified, separated by commas.

option.name: -N
tip: Provide a new passphrase.

option.name: -O
tip: Specify a key or certificate option.
May be specified multiple times.
The accepted options depend on the operation; see the CERTIFICATES, MODULI GENERATION and FIDO AUTHENTICATOR sections.

option.name: -p
tip: Requests changing the passphrase of a private key file instead of creating a new private key.
Updating the passphrase re-encrypts the key, allowing the cipher and KDF rounds to be changed.

option.name: -P
tip: Provide the old passphrase.

option.name: -q
tip: Silence ssh-keygen.

option.name: -Q
tip: Test whether keys have been revoked in a KRL.
If -l is also specified, the contents of the KRL are printed.

option.name: -r
tip: Print the SSHFP fingerprint resource record for the specified hostname and public key file.

option.name: -R
tip: Remove all keys belonging to a hostname from a known_hosts file.

option.name: -s
tip: Certify (sign) a public key using the specified CA key.
When generating a KRL, this specifies a path to a CA public key file.

option.name: -t
tip: Specify the type of key to create.
Also selects the signature type when signing certificates with an RSA CA key. The default is rsa-sha2-512.

next.name: ecdsa
tip: Elliptic Curve Digital Signature Algorithm.

next.name: ecdsa-sk
tip: ECDSA with security key (FIDO2).

next.name: ed25519
tip: ED25519 key.

next.name: ed25519-sk
tip: ED25519 with security key (FIDO2).

next.name: mldsa44-ed25519
tip: ML-DSA-44 key with Ed25519.

next.name: rsa
tip: RSA key.

next.name: rsa-sha2-256
tip: RSA signature variant (SHA-256) when signing with an RSA CA key.

next.name: rsa-sha2-512
tip: RSA signature variant (SHA-512, the default) when signing with an RSA CA key.

next.name: ssh-rsa
tip: Legacy RSA SHA-1 signature. Not recommended.

option.name: -u
tip: Update a KRL: keys listed on the command line are added to the existing KRL rather than a new one being created.

option.name: -U
tip: Indicate that a CA key resides in an ssh-agent, for use with -s or -Y sign.

option.name: -v
tip: Verbose mode. Causes ssh-keygen to print debugging messages about its progress.
Multiple -v options increase the verbosity, up to a maximum of 3.

option.name: -V
tip: Specify a validity interval when signing a certificate.
A single time means the certificate is valid from now until that time; two times separated by a colon give an explicit interval.
Times accept YYYYMMDD[HHMM[SS]] form, or a relative time such as +52w1d, -4w:+4w or always/forever.

option.name: -w
tip: Specifies a path to a library used when creating FIDO authenticator-hosted keys, overriding the internal USB HID support.

option.name: -y
tip: Read a private key file and print the corresponding public key to stdout.

option.name: -Y
tip: SSH signature operations.

next.name: check-novalidate
tip: Check a signature without validation.

next.name: find-principals
tip: Find the principal(s) in a signature.

next.name: match-principals
tip: Find allowed principals for a signer identity.

next.name: sign
tip: Sign a file using an SSH signature.

next.name: verify
tip: Verify a signature.

option.name: -z
tip: Specify a serial number embedded in the certificate. The default is zero.
When generating a KRL, -z specifies a KRL version number.

option.name: -Z
tip: Specify the cipher to use for encrypting an OpenSSH-format private key file.
The default is aes256-ctr.
